description: Fetches the complete list of RIAA Diamond certified albums from worldmusicviews.com, including artist names, album titles, certification dates, and record labels.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_riaa_diamond_albums: 获取RIAA钻石认证专辑列表，可按艺术家、年份范围筛选; 参数: min_year, max_year, limit, artist; 必填: 无

min_year.description: Minimum certification year filter. Used by get_riaa_diamond_albums.

max_year.description: Maximum certification year filter. Used by get_riaa_diamond_albums.

limit.description: Maximum number of albums to return. Used by get_riaa_diamond_albums.

artist.description: Filter albums by artist name (case-insensitive partial match). Used by get_riaa_diamond_albums.
